notes: d9mt is D3D9 straight onto Metal: it replaces DXVK and the Vulkan driver
under it, not just one of them. tools/d9mt/stage.sh does not build it —
it stages the products of a d9mt-v2 checkout built with its own scripts
and checks that checkout is at `commit` here. See docs/d9mt.md.
Upstream declares no license. Its driver/ is extracted DXVK 3.0 (zlib)
and its bridge/ is vendored winemetal from DXMT, but the tree itself says
nothing, so nothing from it may be redistributed in a release until it does.

unpinnedDependencies: fetch-deps.sh clones doitsujin/dxvk at --depth 1 of whatever main is
that day, so two stagings of the same d9mt commit are not the same
driver. llvmorg-15.0.7 and the dxbc-spirv submodule are pinned.
Pinning the DXVK clone is a prerequisite for shipping this.
wineTree: Its scripts link the bridge against /Applications/CrossOver.app's wine
tree and install the builtins into it. The unix side is built with
-undefined dynamic_lookup, so the link does not bind to that tree — but
the unixlib ABI it was compiled for is CrossOver's, and the runtime here
is Wine 11.18. Nothing checks that the two agree.
